title: Term Life Insurance Back Installments: Band Measurement with Whole Life Insurance and Universal Life Insurance on the Insured
content:
For the back installment billed for reinstatement on a Term Life Insurance policy, the band measurement face is chosen by the owner's Ashgrove permanent coverage on the same insured, as the Whole Life Insurance and Universal Life Insurance policy records show it.

1. An in-force Ashgrove whole life policy and an in-force Ashgrove universal life policy are both on record for the insured — the band is measured on the term face amount on record plus both permanent face amounts.
2. Exactly one of the two is in force for the insured — the band is measured on the term face amount on record plus that permanent face amount.
3. Otherwise — the band is measured on the term face amount on record alone.

**Hypothetical.** Term face 180000; in-force Ashgrove 20-Pay Whole Life of 50000 on the insured; the insured's universal life policy has lapsed. Band measured on 230000. If the universal life policy of 40000 were in force as well: 270000.
